industry.why: Underweight, carried, on the special topic of 30-Oct-26 ('Why the Defence Industry de-rated from July to October 2026 while Theon's forecasts rose'), whose first dated test, Rheinmetall's print on 5-Nov-26, did not reach this pack, so the conversion question is open and untested; the Bundestag budget vote on 27-Nov-26 is the next. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-11-06 against 2026-09-04, not week on week: F now, F prior, the fourth reading at F; both sectors F. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only); ceasefire talks on Ukraine (headlines, 2 November) are the least-supported cause named last week and move shares for days. One live holding, Theon (3.46%, from 4.05%, Fitness 40.6, memo re-triaged 5-Nov-26), judged in components 4 and 5; no Pool name. Counter-case: estimates have not fallen and the premium compression may already be the exit multiple. Back to C if relative strength leaves F as approvals convert; to F on a signed settlement followed by defence fund outflows.

sector.why: Neutral, carried; the condition ('to D on the electronics names joining the fall, or a fifth F with Theon's re-test finding the group, not its leverage, behind its fall') is half met: Relative strength, 2026-11-13 against 2026-09-11, not week on week: F now, D prior, the fifth reading at F on the track this row has kept, but neither Theon's re-test nor any read of the electronics and optronics names is in the pack, and no source spoke to defence. Component 1 regime, 13-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its 52-week high, still present on Richard's European test and weakening at the margin for the first time: breadth up a third week to 66%, 60%, 62% and 63% of stocks above the 50, 100, 150 and 200-day averages, the three longer ones still below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, cyclicals ahead of defensives over one week and twelve months while defensives lead at four weeks, three months and six months; the causes unread by any reasoned source for a second week, web headlines only, and the headlines lean against the rates squeeze of the 30-Oct-26 read: the Federal Reserve easing, oil below $100). Theon (3.52%) sits here with Thematic Fit/Momentum F and Technical Momentum F; its review is about its own case (component 5). Counter-case: five readings at F is the market's view of the whole industry, and holding this row above the industry on an unread split is generous. To D when Theon's re-test or a source finds the group behind the fall.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No source spoke to the Netherlands this week (a source pack is present, 2026-W43, and it carried nothing country-specific here), relative strength is not graded by country, and Richard's view is G10 and Europe-wide with no country line. An absence is an absence; no tilt.

In force to 13-Nov; Theon is sold when its replacement is bought, under your one-off in/out link.

bullets.text: Sell signal: Theon's relative 200D MA fell 1.53% over the month to the 6-Nov reading, and 1.62% to 10-Nov.
The monthly fall steepened from (0.56%) on 13-Oct and (1.27%) on 3-Nov to (1.62%).
Relative price is 14.7% below its relative 200D MA; the sell signal will stand at 13-Nov.

items.criterion: Sector RS below 50 with Stock RS below 70, read at the month-end

bullets.text: Sell signal at the 30-Oct month-end: Sector RS 21 and Stock RS 32.
Sector RS 10 and Stock RS 15 on 10-Nov, from 4 and 12 on 6-Nov.
Ending it on 30-Nov needs Sector RS of 50 or Stock RS of 70, now 40 and 55 points away.

FY2027 EPS (1.0%) over 3 months and SS PT Net Upgrade Breadth (20%); a lower low on 6-Nov; Theon lags Hensoldt, MilDef and Kongsberg Gruppen.

defs.atr: average true range: each day's high to low, stretched to the previous close on a gap, as a % of the previous close; L5D the last 5 sessions, L1M and L3M the last 30 and 91 calendar days
defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
